{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically too high when sentiment is positive, requiring 1-2 point daily downward correction",
    "Model underforecasts during negative sentiment by 1-2 points daily, correcting toward mean-reversion",
    "When price is below the 7-day moving average, reduce forecasts by aligning with mean reversion bias",
    "When price sharply rallies (3+ day continuous increase), lag behind true outcomes by 0.3-0.5 points daily",
    "Model exhibits mean reversion bias that becomes stronger as forecast horizon extends beyond 15 days",
    "Sentiment turning from positive to negative requires immediate 0.5-1.0 point daily forecast adjustment",
    "When sentiment alternates rapidly (within 3 steps), dampen forecast changes by 50% to reduce noise"
] }
